name: Arugula

companions.note: Both brassicas; share pest pressure so monitor together, but good bed companions

pnw_notes: One of the fastest crops you can grow. Peppery flavor intensifies in cold, which works in its favor in fall. Bolts quickly in summer heat — fall and spring are its seasons. Self-seeds readily; once established in a bed you'll often get volunteers. Harvest young for milder flavor, older for more heat.

frost_hardiness.notes: Survives light frost; hard freeze damages leaves. Row cover extends the season into December. Flavor intensifies with cold.

planting_windows.notes: Direct sow thickly; cut-and-come-again works well at 3–4 in height
Begin harvesting at 3 in; flavor peaks with cool nights
